name: Free Service Handoff Design Portfolio PowerPoint Template
description: An editable service design portfolio for explaining a fictional lending-service brief, customer handoffs, research evidence, prototyping practice and delivery ownership.
longDescription: This free service design portfolio PowerPoint template helps designers explain the work behind a customer experience. Eight original slides cover a fictional brief, an editable service handoff, illustrative research notes, a rehearsal method, delivery ownership, limitations and a collaboration invitation. Its original swimlane visual system uses rust-orange routing blocks, ink typography, pale blue service bands and open white space. Every element is native editable PowerPoint text or shape, using a system font. Replace the fictional case and all visibly marked illustrative figures with your own verified and permitted portfolio material. No third-party artwork, photography, source layout or presentation file is included.
